description: Refined conservation summary restricted to homologs covering the catalytic region, plus N-terminal presequence comparison
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
df=pd.read_csv("/agent/jobs/2fb7d3bc-c93f-41e8-8a0e-1b6aa78e6a58/provenance/sdd3_active_site_conservation.csv")
cols=["60H","63E","64H","135E","153E"]
cov=df[(df[cols]!="-").any(axis=1)]          # sequences covering the catalytic region
print(f"{len(df)} homologs; {len(cov)} cover the catalytic region; {len(df)-len(cov)} are N-terminally truncated/fragments")
summary=[]
for c in cols:
    sub=cov[cov[c]!="-"]
    summary.append(dict(position=c[:-1], expected=c[-1], n_covered=len(sub),
                        n_conserved=int((sub[c]==c[-1]).sum()),
                        pct=round(100*(sub[c]==c[-1]).mean(),1),
                        variants=dict(sub[c].value_counts())))
S=pd.DataFrame(summary); print("\n",S.to_string(index=False))
S.to_csv("/agent/jobs/2fb7d3bc-c93f-41e8-8a0e-1b6aa78e6a58/provenance/sdd3_conservation_summary.csv",index=False)

# --- N-terminal extension / mitochondrial targeting comparison ---
for acc,nm in [("Q5JRX3","PITRM1_HUMAN"),("Q9LJL3","PREP1_ARATH"),("Q12496","SDD3_YEAST"),("P10507","MAS1_YEAST")]:
    j=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",headers=H,timeout=60).json()
    tp=[f for f in j.get("features",[]) if f["type"] in ("Transit peptide","Signal")]
    print(f'{nm:14s} len={j["sequence"]["length"]:5d} transit/signal={[(f["type"],f["location"]["start"]["value"],f["location"]["end"]["value"]) for f in tp]}')
print("\nResidues N-terminal of zinc-ligand His1: SDD3 59 | PITRM1 103 (incl. 33-aa MTS) | AtPreP1 161 | MPPbeta 69")
print("SDD3 is ~44 residues shorter than PITRM1 at the N-terminus, consistent with absence of a cleavable presequence.")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.2))
ax=axes[0]
b=ax.bar([f"{r.position}\n{r.expected}" for r in S.itertuples()],S.pct,
         color=["#4C72B0","#C44E52","#4C72B0","#8C8C8C","#4C72B0"])
for bb,r in zip(b,S.itertuples()): ax.text(bb.get_x()+bb.get_width()/2,r.pct+1.5,f"{r.n_conserved}/{r.n_covered}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0,112); ax.set_ylabel("% conserved among homologs covering the site")
ax.set_title("SDD3 M16 active-site residues across 31 homologs")
ax.set_xlabel("blue = Zn ligand, red = catalytic Glu, grey = second active-site Glu")

ax=axes[1]
lig=["His60 (Zn1)","His64 (Zn2)","Glu153 (Zn3)","Glu63 (cat.)"]
d=[2.05,2.05,2.05,5.51]
c=["#4C72B0","#4C72B0","#4C72B0","#C44E52"]
ax.barh(lig,d,color=c)
ax.axvline(2.2,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(2.3,3.3,"typical Zn-ligand bond 2.0-2.2 A",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("Distance to the zinc position fitted from His60/His64/Glu153 (A)")
ax.set_title("AlphaFold model AF-Q12496-F1: zinc site geometry")
ax.invert_yaxis()
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
